result.summary: Several visual and layout problems: a missing restaurant image, a cut-off restaurant name, a clipped category chip, and a promo card that is cropped at the bottom.

issues.description: The first card in “Popular right now” (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Load a valid image (or a proper fallback) so the card matches the rest of the list.

issues.description: The third “Fastest near you” card name is truncated to “Trattoria Piccol” with no ellipsis or wrap, so the restaurant name is incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines or truncate with an ellipsis so the full name is indicated.

issues.description: The last category chip (“Healthy”) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, implying more filters exist but with no fade or chevron.
issues.suggestion: Add overflow fade, a peek of the next chip, or a scroll indicator so the row doesn’t look clipped.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promo card is cut off by the tab bar, so the rest of the offer and restaurant info are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding so the last card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
